title: 被偷走的微笑 / The Stolen Smile
methods: Decoded actual accepted public AAC; no private TTS or generation cache read.
ffmpeg ebur128 including 100ms momentary records and true peak; astats full track.
BS.1770 per actual sentence and phrase crops; 10ms active energy above -45 dBFS and F0-voiced RMS to avoid silence skew.
Official loudness-QC functions reused for actual pause segmentation and gated momentary measurement.

actual_sentence_measurements.text: On Monday 21 August 1911, when the Louvre was **customarily** closed, the Mona Lisa was **discreetly** **plucked** from its wall.
The **disappearance** went **unnoticed** until the next day, when a painter arriving to **sketch** found a **conspicuous** **gap** of bare **plaster**.
When the museum **reopened**, **curious** **onlookers** queued to **stare at** the **vacant** space where the **masterpiece** had hung.
On 7 September 1911 the poet Guillaume Apollinaire was held **in custody** for about a week, and Pablo Picasso was **interrogated**.
Both were cleared of **involvement** in the **burglary**.
The **intruder** was Vincenzo Peruggia, an Italian who had **temporarily** worked at the Louvre as a glazier.
Having **lurked** in a storeroom on Sunday, he **strode** out **unchallenged** in a workman's smock, the painting **tucked** **beneath** his clothes.
For more than two years it lay **stashed** in a false-bottomed **trunk** in his Paris **lodgings**.
In December 1913 Peruggia **contacted** Alfredo Geri, an art **dealer** in Florence.
The Uffizi's director **authenticated** the painting at Peruggia's hotel; Peruggia was **apprehended** on 11 December 1913.
Citing **patriotism**, he said he wanted it **repatriated**, **mistakenly** believing Napoleon had **looted** it.
In fact Leonardo da Vinci had **accompanied** it to France **at the invitation of** King Francis I.
After **showings** in Italy, the painting was **reinstated** in the Louvre on 4 January 1914.
In June 1914 a **tribunal** **imposed** a **penalty** of a year and 15 days, but he was **imprisoned** for about seven months.
Many historians argue the **heist** **elevated** one **esteemed** **gem** among many **to** the world's most **renowned** painting.
If so, its **fame** began with a **bare** wall.

whole.text: If so, its **fame** began with a **bare** wall.

S17.依据: 全篇结尾句按 07 定下的标准（用户 2026-10-10 同意并要求所有视频统一）：前段 0.8、最后一段“its fame began with a bare wall.” 0.78、前面停 0.4 秒。接点由 结尾句接点.py 自动找：0.8 那遍最后一个标点后最长静音（20 ms）的正中 0.682 s，0.78 那遍（15 ms）的正中 0.757 s，所在帧和两侧各 5 ms 都低于 -55 dB（程序以 08 校准：与人工核实的接点落在同一段静音里）；2026-10-14 用户（第16条）：“我希望这个so有那种嘲讽的语气 意味深长的语气，有点像中文发音 拼音 三声 那种音调，还有就是 if so 后面的这个逗号 不要停顿太久”：配音模型 so 怎么写标点都是一路降下去，整句 0.80 那一遍里 so 的浊音段用 PSOLA 换成三声曲线（140 → 105 → 176 Hz，从中低起、先降后升，像三声 214）、拉长 1.8 倍；逗号后停顿 0.7 → 0.4 秒（标准逗号停顿）；“If so,”比后半句响 5.9 LU，前段 -5.5 dB

findings: The final sentence is quieter than the rest in mean gated loudness; the existing ±2 LU sentence gate alone would still pass it.

If so and the remainder have almost identical mean BS.1770 loudness, but If so has lower active/voiced RMS and a lower strongest 400ms window; this explains why mean-only matching can miss the perceived weak onset.
The intended fall-rise F0 contour remains measurable in the accepted MP4, roughly 138 to 108 to 176 Hz. It should be retained.
S4 and S14 have 3.07 and 3.29 LU short-introduction-to-main differences under the old mean-only phrase metric; these are separate measured dynamics, not proof that all are audible defects.
No digital clipping or nonfinite samples found. Long inter-sentence pauses are extremely quiet. This is not a subjective proof of absence of every noise or synthesis artifact.

repair_proposal.status: Proposal only; no production source or audio changed

minimal_data_changes.effect: Raise If so by 2 dB relative to the remainder; preserve existing PSOLA F0 curve and durations.
Raise the complete last sentence by 1 dB. This is within the existing builder limit ±1 dB.

repair_proposal.selection_criterion: Match the strongest 400ms window of If so and the remainder: existing deficit 2.147 LU, relative gain +2 dB predicts a remaining deficit 0.147 LU. The mean crop difference becomes +1.909 LU, within the existing 2.5 LU adjacent-phrase limit. Equal-length onset comparisons are supplementary because phoneme content differs.
post_build_checks_required: Repeat accepted-MP4 phrase LUFS, voiced RMS, true peak, and onset/timing verification after the later authorized build.
Listen to If so in context; gain predictions do not establish subjective voice quality.
repair_proposal.why_not_master_boost: The accepted file is -24.2 LUFS but already reaches about -0.5 dBTP. Raising the full track uniformly would consume peak headroom; a master target also requires comparison with other accepted chapters, which were outside this audit.

limitations: Word boundaries are estimated from actual energy/F0 and the known sentence; no external forced aligner was used.
Only the accepted original10 audio was audited; no other chapter was materialized for cross-chapter level comparison.
No repaired audio, MP4, PDF, or source mutation was produced.
